newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope to meet Arafat at Vatican on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Pope to meet Arafat at Vatican on Thursday.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will meet Pope John Paul for talks on Thursday, the Vatican said on Thursday.
Chief Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls said the private audience, the fourth meeting between the two men, would take place in the morning.
Arafat will also hold talks with the Vatican "foreign minister" Monsignor Jean-Louis Tauran, Navarro-Valls said in a statement.
Arafat will be in Rome on Thursday for the opening of a photograhpic exhibition, "Bethlehem 2000", which is being sponsored by the United Nations cultural agency UNESCO.
